description: See what you are actually working on, in the columns your team already agreed on. The board reads the Status field of a GitHub Projects v2 board, so Todo, In Progress and QA arrive in the project's own order with each option's description, instead of every assigned issue landing in one pile. A My Tasks filter opens on your own unfinished work, and GitHub's filter syntax works as it does on github.com, including assignee:@me and negation. Group by any single-select field, not only Status. Requires the GitHub CLI signed in on the machine running the BB server, with a classic token carrying the read:project scope, because fine-grained tokens cannot read user-owned projects.
